svg.aria-label: Diagram of Notch stack traces across Java and Notch. Java's main runs report.notch, whose report function calls the Java method Orders.total, which calls a Notch closure that calls withTax and divides by zero. Today's trace is 28 JVM frames with only three of the program's own frames; the new tracer, in development, prints 7 frames that alternate between Java and Notch in call order.
svg.text: Notch — one stack trace across Java and Notch
A tracer I'm building for Notch: errors report the frames you wrote, in order, whichever language they're in.
8 public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
note: threw a java.lang.ArithmeticException · / by zero
28 frames · 3 are yours · no Notch frames
7 frames · every one yours · in call order
Java runs a Notch script, Notch calls back into Java, and Java calls a Notch closure …
… which divides by zero. Today that's 28 JVM frames, mostly the interpreter's own …
… the new tracer splices Notch call sites into the Java trace, so you see your 7 frames, in order.
